title: MCA Launches Corporate Mitra Scheme for MSME Compliance Para-Professionals
summary: Creates certified pool of para-professionals to assist MSMEs with accounting, tax, and secretarial compliance.

blocks.content: Creates certified pool of para-professionals to assist MSMEs with accounting, tax, and secretarial compliance.

items: Eligibility & Age: Open to Indian graduates and final-year students up to 30 years of age.
Training Structure: 12-month program comprising 150 hours online learning on SWAYAM Plus followed by 6 months on-the-job training.
Partner Bodies: Supported by IIT Madras (IIT Pravartak), ICAI, ICSI, and ICMAI.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Union Corporate Affairs Minister: Nirmala Sitharaman.
